name_reason: Convention-compliant fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>: domain chapter_13 is a valid game chapter ID (range 01-30, verified meaningful per dispatch table index 12 = chapter 13), descriptor post_action matches the handler family. No Ghidra address residue. Consistent with all 18 sibling handlers in chpost.c.
purpose: Chapter 13 turn-cycle post-action handler: runs the default win/lose check then layers two independent lose conditions, each setting the game-over status code and playing a chapter dialog page.
logic_summary: Calls fd2_check_battle_end_condition (default win/lose). Cond 1: loops slots runtime_char[0xF..0x1A] (i+0xF for i in 0..0xB) via fd2_check_char_is_dead; loop does NOT early-exit, it sets some_npc_alive=1 the instant any slot reports alive (==0) and runs to completion; if no slot alive, sets data_fd2_chapter_event_or_battle_end_code=1 and shows data_fd2_current_chapter_text page 10. Cond 2: if (int32)data_fd2_battle_turn_counter > 5 AND runtime_char[0x3B] is dead, sets the same status code=1 and shows page 2. Both dialog calls use standard glyph geometry (0xA0000/0x140/0xCD/0x4C/0x4A/0x13, blink 1).

params.name: event_arg
params.semantics: Unused dispatch artifact. The dispatch site (via data_fd2_chapter_post_action_handler_table[12]) passes one cdecl arg, but the body ignores it; the PUSH 0x30; CALL __CHK prologue is the Watcom stack-check artifact. Body casts (void)event_arg.
params.reason: Generic but accurate (it is the dispatch event arg) and carries no address residue; not a param_1 placeholder. Consistent with all sibling handlers in chpost.c. Renaming would only be a family-wide stylistic change, not required.

returns.semantics: No return value. Effects via global data_fd2_chapter_event_or_battle_end_code (0x53ECC) writes and dialog scene side-effects.
